name: scenario_Control_presets_capture_and_restore
description: A preset captures what the device is doing and puts it back later, which is the only feature that reaches across Layouts, Effects, Drivers and Services at once. Proves a surface control drives a real target rather than only moving on screen.

steps.name: aim-a-fader
steps.description: Point fader 1 at the global brightness, which is the shortest path from a surface to visible output.

steps.name: move-it
steps.description: Move the fader, which should drive the target rather than merely record a number.

steps.name: the-target-followed
steps.description: The brightness is what the fader said, so the surface reaches the driver.

steps.name: restart
steps.description: Restart: a surface that forgets what it was aimed at is a surface set up twice.
